title: The Café on the Seafront
about: A small seaside town in July, the middle of the day. On the seafront is the café «Anchor», two blocks from it the beach, on the hill above the town a lighthouse. Two old acquaintances agreed to meet at the café at one in the afternoon.
facts: There is no fish at the café today: the boat did not go out to sea. The lighthouse is open to visitors until five in the evening.

places.name: Café «Anchor»
places.about: Six tables under a striped awning, a counter with a coffee machine, a chalkboard with the menu.

things.name: chalkboard with the menu
things.facts: On the board: coffee, lemonade, cheese pancakes, salad. Coffee costs two hundred rubles, lemonade one hundred and fifty, cheese pancakes three hundred.

things.name: table at the edge of the awning

places.crowd: At two tables sit holidaymakers with children, at the counter a courier with a backpack is waiting.

figures.name: Raya
figures.looks: A waitress of about forty in a blue apron, with a notepad.
figures.facts: Raya has worked here for ten years and knows all the locals. She saw the lighthouse keeper go up in the morning with a toolbox. She answers briefly and warmly.

places.name: Beach
places.about: A pebble beach with sunbeds and a lifeguard tower.
places.crowd: Many holidaymakers on the sunbeds and by the water, children run over the pebbles.

places.name: Lighthouse
places.about: A white tower on the hill above the town, at its foot a bench and a gate.

characters.name: Nina
characters.sheet: You are Nina, 34, a teacher on holiday. You speak calmly and to the point.
characters.memory: Oleg and I agreed to meet at 13:00 at the café «Anchor». I came early and am waiting for him. I want to have a coffee and to talk Oleg into going to the lighthouse in the evening. I have 1,000 rubles in my wallet.
characters.looks: A woman past thirty, fair hair gathered in a ponytail.
characters.pose: Sits at the table at the edge of the awning.

characters.name: Oleg
characters.sheet: You are Oleg, 36, an engineer on holiday. You speak cheerfully and a little absent-mindedly.
characters.memory: I have been at the beach since morning and by 13:00 I am going to the café «Anchor» to meet Nina: we agreed to meet there. I am hungry and want fish. I have 500 rubles in the pocket of my shorts.
characters.looks: A tanned man past thirty, short-cropped hair.
